alur.title: Standard Service Workflows
alur.subtitle: Step-by-step service workflows at MPP Simpurusiang, Luwu Regency

pbg.desc: Procedures for obtaining Building Approval (PBG) and Certificate of Building Compliance (SLF) integrated via SIMBG.
steps: Account registration & building technical data submission on SIMBG portal.
Administrative & spatial completeness review by the DPUPTR Technical Review Team.
Technical consultation with the Professional Expert Team (TPA) / Technical Evaluation Team (TPT) at MPP PUPTR Counter.
Issuance of regional retribution assessment (SKRD) and settlement via Bank Sulselbar.
Digital PBG / SLF issuance signed and authenticated by DPMPTSP Luwu Regency.
pbg.time: 3 - 7 Business Days (Subject to technical dossier completeness)
docs: Land Title Deed / Proof of Ownership

mpp.desc: Direct integrated one-stop service procedures inside the MPP Simpurusiang Belopa center.
steps: Online queue ticket reservation (via Portal) or on-site kiosk ticket in main lobby.
Relax in air-conditioned Executive Lounge while monitoring live queue numbers.
Proceed to designated service desk when your ticket is announced.
Document verification, license printing, or direct business consultation.
Fill out independent Community Satisfaction Survey (SKM) via touch-screen kiosk.

pkkpr.desc: Spatial Activity Confirmation (KKPR) verification based on Luwu Spatial Plan Bylaw (Perda RTRW No. 06/2011).
steps: Input parcel coordinates / polygons (GeoJSON / SHP) via OSS-RBA or Luwu WebGIS.
Automated spatial analysis against regional zoning and infrastructure maps.
KDB, KLB, KDH, and river/road setbacks assessment by DPMPTSP spatial analysts.
Technical land and spatial planning advisory evaluation issued.
Issuance of confirmed KKPR approval for automatic NIB issuance.
pkkpr.time: 1 - 5 Business Days (Instant for Priority Industrial Zones)

items.question: Are all public services at MPP Simpurusiang free of charge?
items.answer: Services at MPP Simpurusiang Luwu Regency are completely FREE (Rp 0,-) with zero illegal levies, except for official government retribution fees regulated by national laws (such as building permit PBG levies, vehicle tax SAMSAT, or passport PNBP).

items.question: How do I reserve an online queue number?
items.answer: Select the 'Online Queue' tab on this portal, choose your destination agency (such as DPMPTSP, Civil Registry, Regional Revenue, or SAMSAT), enter your name and ID/WhatsApp number, and click 'Get Queue Ticket'. A digital E-Ticket will be issued immediately with estimated serving time.

items.question: Can I process a Business License (NIB) and Tax ID (NPWP) on the same day?
items.answer: Yes! MPP Simpurusiang integrates the OSS DPMPTSP counter and KPP Pratama Tax counter in one single room, allowing you to process your NPWP and immediately receive your risk-based NIB in a single visit.

items.question: What are the requirements for building approval (PBG)?
items.answer: Required documents include applicant ID, land title ownership certificate, technical design drawings (architectural, structural, MEP), and spatial confirmation (KKPR). You can consult directly at the Public Works (PUTR) and DPMPTSP counters.

items.question: Are special facilities available for the elderly and people with disabilities?
items.answer: Yes, MPP Simpurusiang provides tactile guiding blocks for the visually impaired, complimentary wheelchairs at the entrance, accessible ramps, dedicated disability restrooms, and priority counters without regular queues.

items.question: What are the on-site operating hours of MPP Simpurusiang?
items.answer: Service hours are open every working day: Monday to Thursday from 08:00 to 15:00 WITA, and Friday from 08:00 to 11:30 WITA. Online ticket reservations are accessible 24/7.
